persuasionAngle.rationale: Solo founders obsess over time-to-first-dollar because runway is short and every day matters. Showing actual payment success in minutes addresses their core fear: 'What if I waste weeks on payments integration while my idea loses momentum?' The code snippet proves it's real, not marketing fluff.
persuasionAngle.psychFramework: Fear of opportunity cost + proof through demonstration

creative.headline: First payment in 7 minutes
creative.introText: Just shipped your MVP? This is how @indie_founder got paid $29.99 seven minutes after adding Stripe. Copy-paste ready.
creative.tone: Confident but not cocky. Facts over hype. Peer-to-peer rather than corporate-to-customer. Assumes technical competence without being condescending.
